# commander_new_pam_cloud (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up a **new (NSF) PAM cloud** record by **UID**.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing new (NSF) PAM cloud record by UID.
data "commander_new_pam_cloud" "existing" {
  pam_cloud = "_REPLACE_WITH_RECORD_UID_"
}

output "pam_cloud_id" {
  description = "Record UID from the data source read."
  value       = data.commander_new_pam_cloud.existing.id
}

output "pam_cloud_title" {
  value = data.commander_new_pam_cloud.existing.title
}

output "pam_cloud_url" {
  value = data.commander_new_pam_cloud.existing.url
}

output "pam_cloud_account_identifier" {
  value = data.commander_new_pam_cloud.existing.account_identifier
}

output "pam_cloud_notes" {
  value = data.commander_new_pam_cloud.existing.notes
}

output "pam_cloud_folder" {
  value = data.commander_new_pam_cloud.existing.folder_location
}

# Per-user share permissions. Map key = user email; value = role (viewer, share-manager, content-manager, content-share-manager, full-manager).
output "pam_cloud_share" {
  description = "Per-user share permissions for this record."
  value       = data.commander_new_pam_cloud.existing.share
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pam_cloud` (String) PAM cloud record **UID** to read.

### Read-Only

- `account_identifier` (String) **Account identifier** of the cloud resource.
- `folder_location` (String) Folder **UID** or path to store PAM cloud record in your Keeper vault. If not provided, the record will be stored in the root path of vault.
- `id` (String) The PAM cloud record **UID** assigned by Keeper after create.
- `notes` (String) **Notes** for this PAM cloud record.
- `share` (Map of String) Mapping of share permissions for this folder or record. For folders, keys can identify either users (**UID** or **email**) or teams (**UID** or **name**). For records, keys can identify users only (**UID** or **email**). Values specify the permission level: `viewer`, `share-manager`, `content-manager`, `content-share-manager`, or `full-manager`. The owner is implicit and never present in this map; the API rejects owner entries.
- `title` (String) **Title** of the PAM cloud record.
- `url` (String) **URL** of the cloud resource.
